caption: The drawing depicts an interior scene featuring four large wooden columns in the foreground, arranged in a row from left to right. Behind the columns, there are several wooden benches with high backs and armrests, aligned parallel to the columns. The walls and ceiling are made of horizontal logs, with the logs rendered in brown and beige tones. The ceiling has wooden beams and an exposed ventilation pipe running diagonally across the upper left portion. The floor is composed of evenly spaced wooden planks in shades of muted gray and brown. Light and shadow are visible on the surfaces, emphasizing the wood texture, and the overall color palette consists mainly of browns, yellows, reds, and grays, contributing to a warm, natural appearance.
title: Muskego Church
